question: Tina alone can do a piece of work in 12 days and Meena alone can do the same work in 15 days, If Tina and Meena undertook to do this work for Rs. 18,000, then how much amount will Meena get, if they work together?
solution:
Given:

Tina can do a piece of work in 12 days

Meena can do a piece of work in 15 days

Concept used:

If A can do work in n days then one day work of A will be 1/n

Calculation:

According to the problems 

A = 12 × 5 = 60

B = 15 × 4 = 60

LCM of 12 and 15 = 60

A can do 5 unit in one day

B can do 4 unit in one day 

Total days to complete work = 60/9 days =20/3

Meena does 4 × (20/3) units of work 

⇒ frac{{4 times frac{{20}}{3}}}{{60}} times 18000 = 8000

∴ Meena will get Rs. 8000.
